The next generation of dispatching automation system should be built up with the consideration of the following aspects: (1) the system should have the capability to support power market; (2) the system should be built with open architecture; (3) the system should support the application of artificial intelligence; (4) the system should adopt component technology; (5) the system should provide security of power system.
